description: The Ori invasion reaches the Milky Way in force, led by Adria, while SG-1 continues the hunt for Merlin’s anti-Ori weapon. The team battles Priors, Ori warships and old enemies as the long search for a way to defeat the ascended Ori reaches its final stage.

s10e01.description: After the Ori fleet’s devastating arrival, SG-1 struggles to regroup while Vala gives birth to Adria, a rapidly growing child created to command the invasion.

s10e02.description: An alien parasite leaves SG personnel trapped in a sleep they may never wake from, forcing the team to search the infected world for a cure.

s10e03.description: SG-1 travels to Atlantis to connect two Stargates across galaxies and use the network against Ori ships, drawing McKay into the mission.

s10e04.description: Ba’al and his clones are captured, but separating host from symbiote becomes dangerous when none of them agrees on which Ba’al is the original.

s10e05.description: Invisible alien predators begin attacking around Earth after SG-1 brings home technology that shifts living creatures between dimensions.

s10e06.description: Martin Lloyd asks SG-1 for help with the 200th episode of Wormhole X-Treme, sending the team through increasingly absurd versions of their own adventures.

s10e07.description: A Jaffa strike against an Ori-held world destroys civilians and pushes Adria toward retaliation while the Free Jaffa government begins to fracture.

s10e08.description: Vala loses her memory and builds a new life on Earth, unaware that people connected to her past are hunting her.

s10e09.description: Mitchell infiltrates a criminal group that has taken over the Odyssey, but the gang’s internal rivalries make rescue increasingly dangerous.

s10e10.description: SG-1 follows Arthurian clues to a legendary quest whose tests may reveal Merlin’s weapon, while Adria closes in on the same prize.

s10e11.description: The search for Merlin’s weapon continues as SG-1 confronts a dragon, Ba’al and Adria in a race to recover the Ancient device first.

s10e12.description: Carter tests a device that can hide an entire village from the Ori, but a technical failure leaves the settlement exposed to attack.

s10e13.description: Carter is thrown into an alternate reality where the Stargate program is public, America is under martial law and her counterpart changed history.

s10e14.description: Daniel returns transformed into an Ori Prior and asks SG-1 to trust a plan that depends on Merlin’s weapon and an enormous risk.

s10e15.description: A bounty on SG-1 turns Mitchell’s high-school reunion into a hunting ground for alien mercenaries.

s10e16.description: SG-1 poses as criminals during a mission and is mistaken for genuine thieves during a hostage crisis inside an alien museum.

s10e17.description: Teal’c pursues the Jaffa responsible for killing his mother and other villagers, putting revenge ahead of SG-1’s orders.

s10e18.description: Vala’s estranged father arrives on Earth claiming to have information that can help the SGC, leaving everyone to wonder which part of his story is the con.

s10e19.description: SG-1 captures Adria and discovers that Ba’al has placed a symbiote inside her, creating a three-way struggle for control of the Ori leader.

s10e20.description: The Odyssey becomes trapped in a time-dilation bubble under Ori attack, forcing SG-1 to spend decades together while Carter searches for one final escape.
